subject: VPC prepay & support slab — prepayment credits and orchestration fee proposal
messages:
From: Ami Shah <ami.shah@meadowhealth.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Meadow Health: VPC deployment — prepay & support questions

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement has asked me to gather a concise commercial proposal for a private (VPC) deployment. Their asks: a 2–3 year commitment with an upfront prepayment option, clear mapping of the 'orchestration' / platform charge, and what credits or concessions we can provide if they prepay annually vs. monthly.

Specifics they want included:
- Line item for a one-time/private control plane setup vs an ongoing platform/orchestration fee.
- Discounts for full-year prepay (they're targeting 10–15% if possible).
- Support tiers (hours, response times, 24/7 oncall) and price differences.
- Any onboarding credit / migration credit we can provide.

I've attached the procurement RFP for context (Meadow_RFP_03022026.pdf). Can you send a summarized proposal and a recommended commercial approach? Legal will want a draft SOW and SLA redlines as follow-ups.

Best,
Ami
Procurement Lead, Meadow Health

(attachment: Meadow_RFP_03022026.pdf)

From: jonas.weber@redwood.com
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: soojin.lee@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Meadow Health: VPC deployment — prepay & support questions

Team — forwarding procurement note from Meadow Health. High priority: enterprise buying cycle, potential to scale across their telehealth stack. Quick take:

Proposal sketch (for internal alignment):
- Term: 2 years preferred (customer wants 2–3).
- Commitment: target $1.2M ARR equivalent (we can flex).
- Prepay option: 10% off ARR if paid annually up front; 12% if they do 2 years upfront.
- Orchestration fee: suggest $18k/mo (base private control plane) — amortize first-year onboarding fee into month 1 invoice or spread over first 12 months per their accounting preference.
- Support tiers:
  * Standard: business hours support (8x5), 24h bug triage, 4 business-hour P1 response — included.
  * Premier: 24x7 oncall + 2-hr P1, quarterly runbook reviews, 2x SME days / quarter — +$9k/mo.
  * Premier+ (exec support): scoped SRE runbook ops and on-call rotation shadowing — add-on.
- Onboarding credit: offer $50k credit if they sign within 30 days (applied against orchestration fee / first invoice).

I attached a working worksheet (RDW-Pricing-Worksheet-20260310.xlsx) with numbers. Can you weigh in on the percent flexibility we can offer and whether Legal will accept the amortization approach? I'll own getting the SOW draft out once we land pricing.

-JW

From: soojin.lee@redwood.com
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 04 Mar 2026 11:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Meadow Health: VPC deployment — prepay & support questions

Thanks, Jonas. Quick pricing/policy notes from pricing & enterprise:

- Discount floor: we shouldn't go below 10% on true ARR prepay for deals in this band without approval from Revenue Ops. 12% requires 2-year full prepay and an upsell milestone (i.e., commit to a 20% usage increase year 2).
- Orchestration fee: OK to amortize over 12 months; Legal prefers a clear line item in the SOW stating the fee and the amortization method so finance can book it cleanly.
- Support SLAs: propose we define credits as % of monthly invoice: P1 > 99.5% = no credit; 99.0–99.5% = 5% credit; <99.0% = 10% credit, capped at 20% annually. This is what Sales Ops has used.
- Onboarding credit: $50k one-time credit makes sense; apply to first invoice only.

I'll draft the SOW with those bullets and include a named clause for data residency & audit (Meadow emphasized HIPAA adjacency). Attaching initial SOW and SLA redlines for review (SOW-DRAFT-20260310.pdf, SLA-Redlines.docx).

If you want to be slightly more aggressive on prepay (up to 12%), we should tighten the cancellation & usage retention language and add a milestone-based rollback.

-Soojin
Director, Enterprise Pricing

From: jonas.weber@redwood.com
To: Ami Shah <ami.shah@meadowhealth.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, soojin.lee@redwood.com

Subject: VPC commercial proposal — Meadow Health (short summary)

Hi Ami — great to connect. Per procurement's ask, here's a concise commercial proposal and the next steps we recommend. Please see attached SOW/Draft SLA and the pricing worksheet.

Summary proposal (two-year example):
- Term: 24 months.
- Committed spend: $1,200,000 ARR equivalent (billed per schedule below).
- Prepay options:
  * Annual prepay: 10% off committed ARR when Meadow pays each 12-month tranche up front.
  * Two-year prepay (full 24 months up front): 12% off total contract value.
- Orchestration / private control plane charge: $18,000 / month. We recognize customers treat this differently; Meadow may elect to have the orchestration fee billed as a one-time setup ($216k) or amortized monthly across year 1. We will reflect the option you prefer on the final SOW.
- Onboarding / migration credit: $50,000 credit applied to first invoice if contract signed within 30 days of this proposal.
- Support tiers:
  * Standard (included): 8x5 support, 4-business-hour P1 response, monthly health checks.
  * Premier (+$9,000/mo): 24x7 oncall, 2-hour P1 response, quarterly runbook reviews, 2 SME-days/quarter.
  * Premier+ (custom pricing): SRE integration and runbook ops (scope to be defined).
- SLA crediting: 99.5% and above = no credits. 99.0–99.5% = 5% monthly credit. Below 99.0% = 10% credit (cap 20% annually).

Attachments: SOW-DRAFT-20260310.pdf, SLA-Redlines.docx, RDW-Pricing-Worksheet-20260310.xlsx.

Next steps:
1) Confirm whether you prefer orchestration billed upfront or amortized monthly.
2) Confirm target support tier (Standard vs Premier).
3) If okay, we'll route a DocuSign with the commercial sheet + 1st SOW and include the onboarding credit. Link to sign: https://www.docusign.com/ee/5f4a2bd9-ndx-sign

We're happy to walk through the worksheet with Procurement and Finance — happy to set a 30-minute call later this week.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
